title: The worker brief and agents/worker.md say to run selfdoc.py stale --since origin/main again after the rebase onto origin/main
goal: the worker brief tells a worker to run selfdoc.py stale --since origin/main again after the rebase onto origin/main, since SP-osevumx6 landings of BG-fwqcimiv and BG-fjptk52z stopped at the stale step on kb/_self/tools.md, which the worker's own pre-rebase run did not list; agents/worker.md says the same

run:
import subprocess,sys
out=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','brief','ST-uh7kxean'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
ph='again after the reb' + 'ase onto origin/main'
ok=(ph in out)==True
print('brief of ST-uh7kxean has: '+ph if ok else 'brief of ST-uh7kxean: want phrase present: '+ph)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('agents/worker.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').lower()
miss=[w for w in ['after the rebase', 'selfdoc.py stale'] if w not in t]
sys.exit('not yet: agents/worker.md lacks '+', '.join(miss) if miss else 0)
